name: Mass Super Skunk
summary: **Mass Super Skunk** is a [[kind:cut|cut]] first selected by growers in Western Massachusetts in the late 1980s. It is described as a cross of [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]] and [[hash-plant|Hash Plant]], propagated only as a clone. Its exact breeder is not documented.

sources.title: Mass Super Skunk: The East Coast Foundation
sources.note: Its claim that Mass Super Skunk crossed with a Northern Lights male produced Chem 91 conflicts with the already-cited High Times account on the chemdawg card, so that part was left out here.
